text.tspan: 12 · Decision: public VIF to S3 (C), private VIF fallback (B), offline seed (F)
Keep the Transit Gateway for platform services: bulk transfers over the TGW add $0.02/GB each way
and compete with Vault replication and DNS. Size Direct Connect for data, or add QoS.
drives taken to an AWS site (F)
